# French Wiktionary Fixture Notice

`frwiktionary-20260901.jsonl` contains four records from the raw Kaikki/Wiktextract
extraction of the French Wiktionary 2026-09-01 dump. The extraction completed on
2026-09-08.

The records remain available under the source terms, including
[CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) and the
[GNU Free Documentation License 1.3](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/fdl-1.3.html).
See the [Kaikki source information](https://kaikki.org/frwiktionary/), the French
Wiktionary [copyright page](https://fr.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionnaire:Copyright),
and the source pages for [éléphant](https://fr.wiktionary.org/wiki/éléphant),
[échelle](https://fr.wiktionary.org/wiki/échelle), and
[livre numérique](https://fr.wiktionary.org/wiki/livre_numérique).

The repository's Apache-2.0 OR MIT license does not apply to these records. Exact
source revisions, hashes, locators, and retrieval details are in
`frwiktionary-20260901.provenance.json`.
